name: Bhagavad Gita 2.47
text:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥
meaning: Your concern is with the action alone, never with its fruits. Do not work only for rewards, and do not cling to doing nothing.
purpose: A verse on acting fully without being ruled by the outcome.
supports: Work without anxiety over results; steadiness after effort; avoiding paralysis.
when: Before work, an examination, or anything whose outcome worries you.
